meta.note: Fallback course (the Black Snake / Cedar Glades / Music Mountain roads only make 9-16 km loops): the Hot Springs Mountain summit circuit at sunset. Hot Springs Mountain Drive south-west along the west flank past the picnic area, the Pagoda, North Mountain Drive past the Tower and over the summit, back to the top of the Drive.
